nodes.author: MountVesuvio
nodes.text: hMPV has always been here since years. This time last year I was signing off positive hMPV reports on a normal basis. Winters bring influx of all sorts of viruses, and hMPV is normal in kids. This current influx is not China based but has come in news due to Chinese outbreak.

nodes.author: MountVesuvio
nodes.text: The noise media is making today regarding hMPV is nothing but whole lot of misrepresentation, fear mongering and incomplete ground research. Do better. At this point, general panic needs to be avoided. Look at the people as well as the stock market reacting to this news! Not good

nodes.author: RDAmbekar
nodes.text: @MountVesuvio Distraction from actual problems in country, isn’t that total job description of media nowadays?

nodes.author: MountVesuvio
nodes.text: @RDAmbekar Even if so, the general panic such news (without proper research!) creates is not healthy for anyone, the government or the citizens.
